title: Cyber Circuit Racing
description:
Race and drift through this futuristic city against other players!
Everyone has their car tuned up and nitro boosts installed.
Use your boost often, but be tactical with it. Momentum will carry on after boosting.
Managing your momentum is crucial! Try to drift around turns!
Use item = burst of speed, 1 second cooldown.
Every lap gives 10 points! Race finishes when first driver reaches 50 points or 120 second timer runs out.

Ai players not supported.

Music by: Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio
Check out the song here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W54cb2HL6Sk
